maria: starting quick onboarding for customer Nebula's LoRA onto pegasus-2x. focus: tokenizer remap + int4 smoke.

sam: got it. Nebula uses 3 private tokens; do we have their token_map applied?

maria: yes, token_map at customers/nebula/token_map.json. saw one long prompt truncate in local run.

eli: paste minimal repro and metrics?

maria: small local run:
```
run: nebula-smoke-2026-03-21
model: pegasus-2x + nebula-lora
quant: int8
rouge_l: 0.41
notes: int4 had 1/20 truncations on long prompts
```

ci-bot: CI smoke created https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/900123 (artifacts pending).

zoe: truncation with remapped tokens usually means KV slot ordering mismatch. try encode->decode roundtrip against token_map.

sam: reproduce command:
```
python -m rw_infer.eval_smoke --model pegasus-2x --adapter customers/nebula/lora.safetensors --token-map customers/nebula/token_map.json --quant int4 --prompts tests/nebula/long.jsonl
```

eli: reserving ded-pegasus-02 for full int4 smoke (ETA 20m). if repro, options: (1) re-merge with host ids, (2) patch runtime KV realignment.

maria: uploading minimal repro to CI. will update when ded run completes. ping @sam @eli. :eyes:
